svg.title: Compare Acquisition-Spread Yields, Not Listing Hype
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-parcel-strategy-spread-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Acquisition-Spread Yields, Not Listing Hype; subtitle: Five independent parcel examples with the same $50,000 sale price; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Each numeric value is gross acquisition spread as a percentage of sale price: (sale price − purchase price) ÷ sale price. These illustrative yields exclude diligence, preparation, closing, selling, carry, and overhead; they are neither net margins nor annualized returns. Examples are independent alternatives, not a weighted portfolio or observed market ranking.; caption: A wide acquisition spread can disappear through access repairs, utility extensions, septic failure, or delayed approvals. The 40% example matches the Base-Case spread before its remaining 21.5 percentage points of modeled expenses.; stages: label: Accessible rural acreage; value: 40% gross spread; numeric value: 40.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $30,000 purchase leaves $20,000 before other costs. Verify recorded access and actual road condition; a cheap landlocked parcel does not become attractive through a larger spreadsheet spread.; label: Utility-served infill lot; value: 35% gross spread; numeric value: 35.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $32,500 purchase leaves $17,500 before other costs. Confirm connection capacity, tap fees, setbacks, and legal-lot status; a utility line near the boundary is insufficient evidence.; label: Septic-dependent homesite; value: 30% gross spread; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $35,000 purchase leaves $15,000 before other costs. Obtain the local authority's required soil and wastewater findings before representing the parcel as suitable for residential construction.; label: Approved minor-split lot; value: 25% gross spread; numeric value: 25.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $37,500 allocated purchase basis leaves $12,500 before other costs. This example assumes an approved, legally created lot; unresolved split applications require separate timing and expense scenarios.; label: Recreational-use parcel; value: 20% gross spread; numeric value: 20.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $40,000 purchase leaves $10,000 before other costs. Verify lawful recreational uses, seasonal access, and restrictions; narrow buyer demand can make even modest carrying costs decisive.

text.title: Compare Acquisition-Spread Yields, Not Listing Hype
text.tspan: Compare Acquisition-Spread Yields, Not Listing Hype

circle.title: label: Accessible rural acreage; value: 40% gross spread; numeric value: 40.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $30,000 purchase leaves $20,000 before other costs. Verify recorded access and actual road condition; a cheap landlocked parcel does not become attractive through a larger spreadsheet spread.

label: Utility-served infill lot; value: 35% gross spread; numeric value: 35.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $32,500 purchase leaves $17,500 before other costs. Confirm connection capacity, tap fees, setbacks, and legal-lot status; a utility line near the boundary is insufficient evidence.

label: Septic-dependent homesite; value: 30% gross spread; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $35,000 purchase leaves $15,000 before other costs. Obtain the local authority's required soil and wastewater findings before representing the parcel as suitable for residential construction.

label: Approved minor-split lot; value: 25% gross spread; numeric value: 25.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $37,500 allocated purchase basis leaves $12,500 before other costs. This example assumes an approved, legally created lot; unresolved split applications require separate timing and expense scenarios.

label: Recreational-use parcel; value: 20% gross spread; numeric value: 20.0; detail: $50,000 resale less $40,000 purchase leaves $10,000 before other costs. Verify lawful recreational uses, seasonal access, and restrictions; narrow buyer demand can make even modest carrying costs decisive.

text.title: Assumptions: Each numeric value is gross acquisition spread as a percentage of sale price: (sale price − purchase price) ÷ sale price. These illustrative yields exclude diligence, preparation, closing, selling, carry, and overhead; they are neither net margins nor annualized returns. Examples are independent alternatives, not a weighted portfolio or observed market ranking.
